verdict: The site is losing trust at the moments that decide whether a visitor acts. 2 critical issues are visible to every visitor and belong at the top of the list.
summary: Audited 4 pages on northwinddental.example across 169 checks. Strongest area: Conversion readiness (89/100). Weakest: Search visibility (55/100). The highest-leverage fix: A form submits over insecure HTTP.

topIssues.title: A form submits over insecure HTTP
topIssues.why: Names, emails, and messages can be intercepted or altered before they reach the business.
topIssues.fix: Point the form action at an HTTPS endpoint and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

topIssues.title: The page has no title tag
topIssues.why: Search results and browser tabs have nothing to identify the page, which suppresses clicks even when it ranks.
topIssues.fix: Add a unique 30–60 character title that names the page's main subject and who it is for.

topIssues.title: 6 images lack alt text
topIssues.why: Screen-reader users miss the content of these images, and search engines miss the context.
topIssues.fix: Describe informative images in alt text; use alt="" for purely decorative images.
topIssues.evidence: 6 of 8 images have no alt attribute.

issues.title: 6 images lack alt text
issues.why: Screen-reader users miss the content of these images, and search engines miss the context.
issues.fix: Describe informative images in alt text; use alt="" for purely decorative images.
issues.evidence: 6 of 8 images have no alt attribute.

issues.title: The mobile viewport is not configured
issues.why: Without a viewport tag, phones zoom out to show a desktop layout and text becomes unreadable.
issues.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
issues.evidence: No viewport meta tag was found.

issues.title: The server took 3.2s to respond
issues.why: Nothing can render until the server responds; a slow first byte caps the experience for everyone.
issues.fix: Add page caching or a CDN, and profile slow plugins or database queries.
issues.evidence: Measured time to first byte: 3240 ms.

issues.title: The page has almost no substantive content
issues.why: Visitors cannot tell what the page covers, and search engines have little evidence of expertise.
issues.fix: Add concrete detail — what the page covers, examples or evidence, and answers to common questions.
issues.evidence: 82 words of primary content were found.

issues.title: A form submits over insecure HTTP
issues.why: Names, emails, and messages can be intercepted or altered before they reach the business.
issues.fix: Point the form action at an HTTPS endpoint and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

issues.title: The page has no title tag
issues.why: Search results and browser tabs have nothing to identify the page, which suppresses clicks even when it ranks.
issues.fix: Add a unique 30–60 character title that names the page's main subject and who it is for.

issues.title: 2 internal links point to missing pages
issues.why: Broken paths waste the authority sent to dead ends and frustrate visitors who were ready to act.
issues.fix: Restore or redirect each missing URL to the most relevant live page.

issues.title: 4 scripts block rendering
issues.why: Parser-blocking JavaScript in the head delays every visible element behind network requests.
issues.fix: Add defer or async, or move non-critical scripts out of the head.
issues.evidence: 4 scripts load synchronously from the document head.

issues.title: There is no meta description
issues.why: Google will write its own snippet, so the page loses control of how it is described in search results.
issues.fix: Write a 120–155 character summary of what the page offers and why it is worth visiting.

issues.title: 3 form fields have no label
issues.why: Screen readers and voice-control tools cannot reliably tell people what to enter.
issues.fix: Add a visible <label for> or an aria-label to every input, select, and textarea.
issues.evidence: 3 of 3 form fields lack a programmatic label.

issues.title: The page loads about 6.4 MB
issues.why: Large pages drain mobile data and load slowly on the connections many customers actually use.
issues.fix: Compress and resize images, use WebP/AVIF, lazy-load below-the-fold media, and remove unused libraries.
issues.evidence: 6.4 MB across 19 resources measured on the homepage.

issues.title: Some resources load over insecure HTTP
issues.why: Mixed content can be blocked by browsers and lets an attacker tamper with assets on an otherwise secure page.
issues.fix: Serve every image, script, stylesheet, and frame over HTTPS.

issues.title: The page has no H1 heading
issues.why: Visitors and search engines lose the page's main topic in the first scan.
issues.fix: Add exactly one descriptive H1 that states the service and the audience.

issues.title: This page is hidden from search engines
issues.why: A noindex directive explicitly removes the page from search results, so no amount of content will rank.
issues.fix: Remove the noindex directive if this page should attract organic traffic.

issues.title: There is no Content Security Policy
issues.why: A CSP limits the damage from injected scripts, the most common serious web vulnerability.
issues.fix: Start with a report-only policy, then enforce a strict allowlist for scripts, styles, and frames.

issues.title: Most images have no width or height
issues.why: The browser cannot reserve space, so the layout jumps as images arrive and hurts Core Web Vitals.
issues.fix: Add width and height attributes (or a CSS aspect-ratio) to every image.

issues.title: The site can be framed by another origin
issues.why: Without clickjacking protection, another site can embed the page and trick visitors into clicking.
issues.fix: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY or add frame-ancestors 'none' to the CSP.
issues.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set.

issues.title: HSTS is not enabled
issues.why: Without HSTS, a first visit can be downgraded from HTTPS to HTTP and exposed to interception.
issues.fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a long max-age after confirming every subdomain supports HTTPS.

issues.title: 14 separate scripts load on this page
issues.why: Many scripts compete for bandwidth and main-thread time, even when each one is small.
issues.fix: Audit the tags actually needed and consolidate or remove the rest.

issues.title: The page has multiple H1 headings
issues.why: Competing H1s blur the primary topic and make the page harder to scan.
issues.fix: Keep one H1 for the page's main promise and demote the rest to H2/H3.

issues.title: The title is likely to be truncated in search results
issues.why: Google typically cuts titles around 60 characters, hiding the differentiating part of the message.
issues.fix: Tighten the title to 60 characters or fewer, keeping the main subject first.
issues.evidence: The title is 91 characters: “Home | Northwind Family Dental | Family, Cosmetic and Emergency Dentist in Portland, Oregon”.

issues.title: There is no visible social proof
issues.why: Testimonials, reviews, and ratings reduce the perceived risk of choosing an unfamiliar business.
issues.fix: Add a short testimonial, a review rating, or a “trusted by” line near the primary call to action.
issues.evidence: No testimonials, reviews, ratings, or case studies were found on the 4 pages read.

issues.title: MIME sniffing is not disabled
issues.why: Browsers may execute a file as a different type than intended, turning uploads into script.
issues.fix: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.

issues.title: The copyright still says 2023
issues.why: An old date makes an active business look neglected, which undermines trust at the moment of decision.
issues.fix: Update the year automatically, or remove the year from the footer.
issues.evidence: The newest copyright year found is 2023; the current year is 2026.

issues.title: Multiple pages share the same meta description
issues.why: Repeated snippets waste the chance to match each page's specific search intent.
issues.fix: Write a distinct, benefit-led description for every page.
issues.evidence: 2 pages reuse the same meta description.

issues.title: Browser features are not restricted
issues.why: Third-party scripts can request camera, microphone, or location access the site never needs.
issues.fix: Send a Permissions-Policy that disables unused features.

issues.title: The referrer policy is undefined
issues.why: Full URLs can leak to third parties through the Referer header, including sensitive query strings.
issues.fix: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

issues.title: There is no canonical URL
issues.why: Without a canonical, tracking parameters and duplicate paths can split ranking signals.
issues.fix: Add a self-referencing canonical link pointing to the preferred URL.

issues.title: Social share previews are incomplete
issues.why: Links shared in email, Slack, or social feeds will look unfinished and earn fewer clicks.
issues.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and a 1200×630 og:image.

issues.title: Heading levels skip
issues.why: Screen-reader users navigate by headings; skipped levels make the page outline confusing.
issues.fix: Keep heading levels in order and style text with CSS instead of choosing tags by size.
issues.evidence: Heading sequence: H1 → H1 → H3 → H2 → H2.

issues.title: There is no skip-to-content link
issues.why: Keyboard users must tab through the entire navigation to reach the page content.
issues.fix: Add a visually hidden “Skip to content” link as the first focusable element.

issues.title: Positive tabindex values override natural focus order
issues.why: Keyboard focus can jump unpredictably and leave people lost on the page.
issues.fix: Remove positive tabindex values and follow DOM order instead.

issues.title: Most images load eagerly
issues.why: Below-the-fold images compete with the hero and delay the content customers came to see.
issues.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the first viewport; keep the hero eager.

issues.title: 6 separate stylesheets delay rendering
issues.why: Each stylesheet is render-blocking and many are mostly unused.
issues.fix: Bundle critical CSS, defer the rest, and remove unused framework styles.

issues.title: No structured data for search engines
issues.why: Without schema markup, search engines lack explicit details about the organisation or person behind the site.
issues.fix: Add appropriate JSON-LD — for example Organization for a company or Person for a personal site — with the name, description, and relevant profile links.

issues.title: The server reveals its software version
issues.why: Version numbers help attackers target known vulnerabilities and add no value for visitors.
issues.fix: Hide server tokens and version strings at the server or CDN layer.

emails.subject: 36 fixable issues on northwinddental.example
emails.body:
Hi,

I ran a public audit of northwinddental.example — 4 pages and 169 checks, all from the outside.

Here is what stood out:

1. A form submits over insecure HTTP
   Evidence: 1 form actions use http://.
   Fix: Point the form action at an HTTPS endpoint and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

2. The page has no title tag
   Evidence: No <title> element was found.
   Fix: Add a unique 30–60 character title that names the page's main subject and who it is for.

3. 6 images lack alt text
   Evidence: 6 of 8 images have no alt attribute.
   Fix: Describe informative images in alt text; use alt="" for purely decorative images.

The site scores 70/100 overall, with search visibility as the biggest opportunity. 2 of them are critical and visible to every visitor.

I have the full 36-item dossier ready, including the page-by-page evidence and a 30/60/90 plan.
